digest.component_or_area: Jira DC parent/hierarchy sync, outbound reconciler emit
propositions: _resolve_local_parent returns (False, None) indistinguishably for both bound non-epic parents and unbound parents, so parent divergence never enters fields and bridge_alerts apparatus remains unreachable
A non-epic parent that the tracker cannot represent must produce a durable operator-visible record (bridge alert) instead of silently omitting the field and reporting convergence
DC silently accepts PUT fields.parent on sub-tasks and ignores it (req-0056/0058); nulling it returns 400 both ways (req-0055/0057); sub-task editmeta exposes no parent field (req-0054)

The three failing test cells were wrong oracles asserting operations the platform cannot perform, not symptoms of the emit-time defect; re-homing to Epic Link-based assertions preserves the subject and contracts
Reconcile passes can already land parent changes on DC via Epic Link on non-sub-task children (test_outbound_epic_parent_reaches_dc_THROUGH_A_RECONCILE_PASS PASSED run 30964805133)
After fix (Gerrit 1399/1400 merged): all three cells PASSED run 30964805133 with zero failures in entire live external suite, platform limit on sub-task reparent still pinned
